styleText: Steampunk over the ruins of the Old World: brass and steam, airships over Lisbon and Geneva, the glow of etherite, the Steam League, orcish Ghar. Orchestral-mechanical: strings and brass with ticking clockwork percussion, a pipe organ hum, accordion and Portuguese guitar colours, 19th-century adventure romance with a touch of melancholy.

rows.prompt: Instrumental background music for a tabletop role-playing session. World and musical style: Steampunk over the ruins of the Old World: brass and steam, airships over Lisbon and Geneva, the glow of etherite, the Steam League, orcish Ghar. Orchestral-mechanical: strings and brass with ticking clockwork percussion, a pipe organ hum, accordion and Portuguese guitar colours, 19th-century adventure romance with a touch of melancholy. Mood: wonder and curiosity, a strange place slowly unfolding, discovery, wide and airy. Shaped to loop in the background: a steady texture from the first second, no long intro, no big final cadence, no fade-out, ending as it begins so it can repeat. Even dynamics; nothing sudden or jarring. No vocals, no lyrics, no singing. About 60 seconds long.
